_about: Outdoor portrait starting points for the Z8, merged into camera-presets.json by tools/ready.sh --install-presets. Aperture priority with Auto ISO OFF (set on the camera): the camera picks the shutter, the ISO stays where it is put. 'Outdoor sun' holds back a third of a stop because skin and sky clip first in direct sun. In A mode watch the shutter speed the page shows: slower than 1/125 s on a person, raise the ISO.
